name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan tracked 6 Chinese military aircraft and 12 warships in the 24 hours to 23 Nov; no blockade or clash
state: Taiwan's defence ministry tracked six PLA aircraft sorties and 12 navy ships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 23 Nov, with five sorties crossing the median line (Taiwan MND). Earlier in November Taiwan flagged more than 100 PLA navy and coast guard vessels across the western Pacific and a one-day high of 49 sorties (SCMP). Activity has eased since then and no blockade, clash or severed channel was found to 25 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Travellers to Taiwan can check FCDO travel advice. Firms reliant on Taiwan Strait shipping or chip supply are exposed if large-scale drills resume; routine patrols have not disrupted traffic.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan in early November (100+ vessels); no blockade, quarantine or clash

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
